name: Aldrassil
summary: Aldrassil is the colossal bough-tree and settlement nestled at the heart of Shadowglen in northeastern Teldrassil. Serving as the primary refuge and training ground for young kaldorei, its carved hollows shelter trainers, merchants, and local leadership.

sections.title: Heart of Shadowglen
sections.body: Rising high above the secluded vale of Shadowglen, Aldrassil functions as both shelter and civic hub for young night elves taking their first steps in the world. Built into and around the colossal trunk of this ancient growth, winding ramps lead past class trainers and artisans to the high roost where Tenaron Stormgrip oversees the glade's protection. While the world bough Teldrassil stretches across the horizon, Aldrassil provides a safe, grounded canopy where novices learn their arts before venturing down into the troubled wilds of Kalimdor.

faq.answer: Aldrassil is the massive, hollowed-out tree and settlement situated in the center of Shadowglen, northeastern Teldrassil. It serves as the starting haven where young night elves gather training, goods, and guidance.

faq.q: Who leads the settlement at Aldrassil?
faq.answer: Tenaron Stormgrip oversees Shadowglen from his roost at the very top of Aldrassil, coordinating the defense of the vale and guiding newly awakened kaldorei.

faq.q: What services can be found here?
faq.answer: The tree houses class trainers for young night elf warriors, rogues, druids, hunters, and priests, alongside local supply merchants, armorers, and questgivers attending to the immediate needs of the glade.

angles.text: For many young kaldorei, the carved hollows and ramps of Aldrassil are their first memory of civic life and the foundation of their early training.
Aldrassil demonstrates the kaldorei affinity for living architecture, shaped from living wood without breaking the balance of the forest.
